title: Play Date
lyrics:
[00:15.54]You call me on the telephone, you feel so far away
[00:19.38]You tell me to come over, there's some games you wanna play
[00:23.20]I'm walkin' to your house, nobody's home
[00:26.99]Just me and you and you and me alone
[00:31.12]We're just playin' hide and seek, it's gettin' hard to breathe
[00:35.57]Under the sheets with you
[00:38.86]I don't want to play no games, I'm tired of always chasin'
[00:43.62]Chasin' after you
[00:46.63]I don't give a **** about you anyways
[00:50.15]Whoever said I gave a **** 'bout you?
[00:54.25]You never share your toys or communicate
[00:58.00]I guess I'm just a play date to you
[01:09.88]Wake up in your bedroom and there's nothin' left to say
[01:13.60]When I try to talk, you're always playin' board games
[01:17.45]I wish I had Monopoly over your mind
[01:21.28]I wish I didn't care all the time
[01:25.30]We're just playin' hide and seek, it's gettin' hard to breathe
[01:29.76]Under the sheets with you
[01:33.13]I don't wanna play no games, I'm tired of always chasin'
[01:37.84]Chasin' after you
[01:40.74]I don't give a **** about you anyways
[01:44.44]Whoever said I gave a **** 'bout you?
[01:48.44]You never share your toys or communicate
[01:52.22]I guess I'm just a play date to you
[01:57.10]Ring around the Rosie
[02:00.77]I never know, I never know what you need
[02:04.95]Ring around the Rosie
[02:08.51]I wanna give you, wanna give you what you need
[02:17.55]I don't give a **** about you anyways
[02:21.28]Whoever said I gave a **** 'bout you?
[02:25.04]You never share your toys or communicate
[02:29.08]I guess I'm just a play date to you
[02:33.11]Ooh, ooh, ooh
[02:40.63]You know I give a **** about you every day
[02:44.58]Guess it's time that I tell you the truth
[02:48.57]If I share my toys, will you let me stay?
[02:52.16]Don't wanna leave this play date with you
